source_title: Early blight in tomato and potato
description: UMN Extension describes leaf spots that begin as small dark marks on older lower foliage; larger spots may show target-like concentric rings. The disease can affect leaves, fruit, and stems.
symptoms: Small dark spots on older lower foliage
Larger spots may show concentric rings

source_title: Late blight of tomato and potato
description: UMN Extension identifies Phytophthora infestans as a water mold and reports that late blight favors cool, damp conditions.
symptoms: White growth may appear in high humidity

source_title: Bacterial spot of tomato and pepper
description: UMN Extension reports small brown circular leaf spots, sometimes with yellow halos; several related Xanthomonas bacteria cause the disease.
UMN Extension notes the tomato leaf mold pathogen can survive on and in tomato seed and that high humidity is important to this disease.
